Recursive Reasoning Glossary

This page defines the core terms used across Gollek’s recursive-reasoning module, report, compare, and workflow docs.

Use it when you understand the general flow but want a fast vocabulary reference for artifact names, rollout language, and inspector selectors.

See also:

  • Recursive Reasoning Docs
  • Recursive Reasoning Workflow
  • Recursive Reasoning Dataset API
  • Recursive Reasoning Artifact Examples
  • JBang Examples Catalog

Terms

baseline report

The earlier recursive-reasoning-report.json artifact used as the left-hand or comparison-anchor side in a recursive-reasoning compare flow.

bundle

A generated directory of comparison artifacts exported by trainer_recursive_reasoning_compare_inspector.java. A bundle includes several JSON files plus a manifest.json.

bundle health

A compact integrity view over a recursive-reasoning compare bundle that answers whether the expected files were written and whether the saved bundle is reopenable through the inspector.

compare bundle

The reusable directory written by the recursive-reasoning compare inspector through bundle=standard.

compare inspector

The JBang entrypoint trainer_recursive_reasoning_compare_inspector.java, used for direct two-report comparisons, saved compare result reopening, and compare bundle reopening.

compare result

The compact saved single-file artifact written by the recursive-reasoning compare inspector through result=standard.

current report

The newer recursive-reasoning-report.json artifact being compared against a baseline report.

delta selector

A compare-oriented selector of the form delta:<field>, used to extract one focused baseline-vs-current difference such as delta:selectedRewardScore or delta:completedTrajectoryCount.

family id

The stable model-family label persisted into recursive-reasoning reports. In the current starter lane it is generative-recursive-reasoning.

in-memory session

The current reference training/session path implemented by InMemoryRecursiveReasoningSession. It is the lightweight starter lane for running recursive rollouts without a larger external trainer runtime.

length-sorted epoch

A DiscreteTokenDatasetEpoch built after sorting examples by combined input and target token length. This reduces padding capacity for variable-length structured reasoning datasets before tensor conversion.

one-report inspection

The workflow where one recursive-reasoning run is inspected on its own without being compared against another report.

parallel sample

One sampled reasoning branch inside a recursive rollout. Multiple parallel samples let the rollout explore more than one latent path before selecting the best trajectory.

padded token batch

A DiscreteTokenDatasetBatch containing rectangular input and target token arrays, masks, original sequence lengths, known solution counts, and metadata. It is still backend-neutral and can be converted later into Gollek tensors, ONNX tensors, LiteRT inputs, GGUF runner inputs, or research tensors.

recursive reasoning report

The persisted artifact recursive-reasoning-report.json that captures the current recursive-reasoning session’s selected trajectory, reward, and compact rollout summary.

stratified dataset split

A train/validation/test split that groups examples by taskId before applying validation and test fractions. Use it when a dataset mixes N-Queens, Graph Coloring, Sudoku, ARC-style grids, or other structured reasoning benchmarks.

report version

The schema marker persisted into recursive-reasoning reports and saved compare artifacts so downstream tools can identify which stable artifact contract they are reading.

rollout summary

The compact count-oriented summary describing how many trajectories were explored, how many completed, and which state ended up selected.

selected state

The final chosen latent state for the winning trajectory after the rollout selection rule has been applied.

selected trajectory

The chosen reasoning path among the sampled trajectories. It is typically identified by the selected trajectory index plus the selected state id.

stochastic latent transition

The transition contract that advances one latent reasoning state to the next while also providing per-step reward and log-probability information.

supervision step

The outer rollout stage in the recursive reasoning process. Each supervision step can contain one or more inner transitions.

transition index

The per-trajectory inner-step counter inside one supervision step sequence.

two-report comparison

The workflow where a baseline report and a current report are compared either directly in the terminal or through a saved compare result or compare bundle.

workflow script

The shell wrapper run_recursive_reasoning_workflow.sh, which runs the demo, synthesizes a changed current report, exports a compare result, exports a compare bundle, and prints follow-up inspector commands.
